system.description:
Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You settle into another life until even the way you wait at a doorway belongs to someone else.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Time
One hour preparation; resolve each new consequential challenge during the encounter.
Target / range / shape
Self and, on Strong, one willing companion; one hour preparation, then the duration of each consequential encounter.
Duration
The prepared identity lasts until abandoned or contradicted; resolve new consequential challenges separately.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Prepare a mundane identity using suitable clothing, a plausible role and information you have obtained about it. Spend one hour establishing the appearance and rehearsing its habits. This card can sustain the identity across an extended infiltration, but grants no memories, language or compulsory authority. For a consequential challenge, the DA states the objective and a binary or cumulative progress target. On completion, that challenge is resolved; do not repeat it for routine interactions with people accepting the same evidence. A new contradiction, suspicious witness or different demand may create a new challenge.

Weak
1 progress; identify one visible inconsistency you can repair in ten minutes with suitable materials.
Standard
2 progress; also learn one expectation the listener openly expresses about your role.
Strong
3 progress; also establish cover for one willing companion as your attendant or colleague if their clothing and behavior support it. That cover lasts until new evidence challenges it, not indefinitely against every observer.
